description: The cost-of-intelligence index: for each GPQA Diamond threshold, the cheapest first-party API price (blended USD per million tokens) at which a model at or above it could be bought, how many times cheaper it has become, and how many months the price takes to halve.
name: eacc_get_cost_of_intelligence

description: Get e/acc's edited daily overview, either the latest issue or a real YYYY-MM-DD date. Use this when the user asks for a daily report rather than a raw chronological list.

date.description: Optional real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest daily report.

lang.description: Stored edition language. Defaults to English. Missing editions return edition_unavailable; no live model calls.

name: eacc_get_daily

description: Get the current e/acc Top 10 with each event's one-based rank. Use this for 'what is hot now' and to discover valid story public IDs; use eacc_get_latest for a chronological news list. Internal heat scores are not returned.

lang.description: Stored edition language. Defaults to English. Missing editions return edition_unavailable; no live model calls.

limit.description: Maximum number of current topics, from 1 to 10.

name: eacc_get_hot_topics

description: Get the latest e/acc items for a 24-hour or 7-day briefing. Prefer selected mode unless the user explicitly asks for every public item. Do not use this for named-topic search or multi-source event context.

category.description: Optional category: ai-models, ai-products, industry, paper, tip, opinion.

lang.description: Stored edition language. Defaults to English. Missing editions return edition_unavailable; no live model calls.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, from 1 to 30.

mode.description: selected returns editorial picks; all returns every public item.

window.description: Time window. Use 24h for a current briefing and 7d for a weekly view.

name: eacc_get_latest

description: Get e/acc's edited monthly report: the month's most important events chosen from its dailies, grouped by section, with an overview. Use this for what happened this month or in a given month; omit month for the latest.

month.description: Optional real month in YYYY-MM such as 2026-09. Omit for the latest monthly report.

name: eacc_get_monthly

description: Get the evolving timeline, latest development, AI digest, and related events for one public story. Pass the Story public_id or story link that eacc_get_hot_topics returned; never invent or infer IDs.

lang.description: Stored edition language. Defaults to English. Missing editions return edition_unavailable; no live model calls.

public_id.description: Story public ID or story link, from eacc_get_hot_topics (Story public_id or links.story); never guess it.

report_limit.description: Maximum number of timeline reports, from 1 to 50.

name: eacc_get_story

description: Get e/acc's edited weekly report: the week's most important events chosen from its dailies, grouped by section, with an overview. Use this for what happened this week or in a given ISO week; omit week for the latest.

week.description: Optional real ISO week such as 2026-W39. Omit for the latest weekly report.

name: eacc_get_weekly

description: Search e/acc by a 2–200 character topic, company, model, product, or person, over the latest 7 days by default or 30 days with window=30d. It searches editorial picks first and automatically expands to all public items only when picks have no result.

category.description: Optional category: ai-models, ai-products, industry, paper, tip, opinion.

lang.description: Stored edition language. Defaults to English. Missing editions return edition_unavailable; no live model calls.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, from 1 to 30.

window.description: Search window: the latest 24 hours, 7 days (default) or 30 days.

name: eacc_search

description: Today's public wallpaper preview and product page. No key or credit required.
name: eacc_wallpaper_today
